isolation.statement: This review used only the preregistered v2.6 review allowlist, the complete target transcript and event chain, and the draft inventory; no annotation pass or lock was available.

findings.description: m01 was labeled constructive although its probability calculation explicitly answers Tour's earlier demand through elicited concessions; m07, by contrast, states a falsifier for Swamidass's own argument without operating on Tour's preceding components.
Once m01 is correctly treated as responsive, it requires a locked earlier-load-bearing target packet for Tour's demand that possibility receive substantive chemical support.
The draft packet focused on expert assembly failure, while Swamidass expressly qualifies Tour's argument from the immense complexity of minimal present cells to the likely simpler first cell.
m05's indispensable nodes inherited the mismatched assembly packet and did not represent Tour's cited lipid-organization and protein-interaction premises or their complexity conclusion.
The draft target stopped before Tour's immediate claim was completed; the omitted continuation states that a second origin would not make the first-origin problem easier.
The selected source excerpt ended in an incomplete clause at the onset of crosstalk rather than at Swamidass's completed contrast that observations show the opposite of a life-teeming universe.
The last eight words of the draft excerpt belong to Swamidass's interruption, so the purported single-speaker Tour act mixed speaker ownership.

repairs.change: Reclassified m01 as responsive and m07 as constructive, preserving the preregistered two-constructive-per-side and eight-responsive sampling counts.
Added an earlier-load-bearing Tour target packet to m01 with an explicit intervening-claim exception, exact excerpt, typed components, dependencies, and revised rationale.
Replaced m05's target excerpt and claim with Tour's modern-cell lipid and protein-interaction complexity argument that Swamidass actually qualifies.
Rebuilt m05's graph as two distinct factual premises supporting a cellular-complexity conclusion, with no overlap or unstated dependency.
Moved m09's target span to Tour's completed immediate claim that an additional independent origin does not ease the first-origin explanation problem.
Trimmed m09 to Swamidass's complete single-speaker explanatory contrast before the interrupted trailing clause.
Removed Swamidass's interruption from m10 and ended the source span after Tour's complete statement that compounded improbability does not reach zero.

thirdReviewTrigger.rationale: Material repairs changed sampling roles, responsive target locks, a component graph, target recency, atomic boundaries, and speaker ownership, each of which independently triggers fresh third review.
